introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.text: Attendify is an attendance monitoring system designed to help educational institutions record and manage student attendance. This privacy policy explains what personal data Attendify processes, why it is processed, how it is protected, and what rights you have.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.intro: The controller responsible for processing your personal data is:
controller.name: Organisation

dataCollected.title: Personal data we collect
dataCollected.accountDescription: This may include your email address, student ID and authentication information.
dataCollected.facialDescription: During registration and when updating your profile, Attendify may collect facial photographs for the facial-recognition functionality used by the attendance system.
dataCollected.attendanceDescription: This may include attendance events, arrival and departure times, classroom information and related attendance status.
dataCollected.telemetryDescription: The system may process technical information generated by the attendance-monitoring system for operation, monitoring and security purposes.

purposes.title: How we use your data
purposes.text: Personal data is processed only for defined purposes related to attendance monitoring, account management, student identification, system operation and security.

legalBasis.title: Legal basis
legalBasis.text: Each processing activity is assigned an appropriate legal basis under Article 6 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Where facial data constitutes biometric data used for uniquely identifying an individual, an applicable condition under Article 9 is established before that processing takes place.

facialData.title: Facial and biometric data
facialData.text: Facial processing is used only for the attendance-monitoring functionality. Attendify assesses whether the processing constitutes biometric processing under the GDPR. Where Article 9 applies, the processing is subject to an appropriate Article 9 condition and additional safeguards.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.text: Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected or as otherwise required by applicable law. Data is deleted when it is no longer required, subject to applicable legal obligations.

sharing.title: Who can access your data
sharing.text: Access to personal data is restricted according to the user's role and the purposes of the system. Educational institution administrators may access attendance information where authorised. External service providers may process personal data only where necessary to provide services to Attendify and under appropriate contractual and data-protection requirements.

internationalTransfers.title: International data transfers
internationalTransfers.text: Where personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, appropriate safeguards are implemented as required by the GDPR.

security.title: Security
security.text: Attendify uses appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, loss or disclosure. These measures include authentication, access controls, secure transmission and appropriate storage protections.

yourRights.title: Your rights
yourRights.intro: Depending on the circumstances and applicable legal requirements, you may have the following rights:
yourRights.access: Right to access your personal data.
yourRights.rectification: Right to have inaccurate personal data corrected.
yourRights.erasure: Right to have your personal data erased where the legal requirements for erasure are met.
yourRights.restriction: Right to request restriction of processing in certain circumstances.
yourRights.objection: Right to object to certain processing activities.
yourRights.portability: Right to data portability where applicable.

requests.title: Exercising your rights
requests.text: To exercise your rights or request information about your personal data, contact the educational institution responsible for your Attendify account.

privacyByDesign.title: Privacy by design
privacyByDesign.text: Attendify is designed to minimise the collection of personal data, restrict access to sensitive information, limit retention and avoid storing unnecessary facial information.

dpia.title: Data protection impact assessment
dpia.text: The facial-data and computer-vision processing is assessed through a Data Protection Impact Assessment to evaluate its necessity, proportionality, risks and appropriate mitigation measures.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: This privacy policy may be updated when the system, processing activities or applicable requirements change. The latest version will be made available through Attendify.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.intro: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.
